evidenceSource: Direct user replies during guided testing in the installed Edge extension

singleImageDraftIntake.scope: User confirmed one new material was visible in the draft list following instructions to drag a local image file onto the pet

draftMetadataPersistence.scope: User changed the material name and note, saved, refreshed the management page, reselected the material, and explicitly confirmed both values remained

singleImageLibraryPromotion.scope: After promoting the material and selecting it in the library, user explicitly confirmed that the image preview displayed normally and the name and note were retained; source-folder cleanup and external image opening were not separately inspected

twoImageBatchGrouping.scope: User selected two local image files and dragged them onto the pet together, then explicitly confirmed that the draft list gained only one material containing two attachments

batchDraftRecycleAndRestore.scope: User moved that draft material to the recycle area, restored it, and confirmed that the draft list still showed one material with both attachments; independent byte comparison was not performed

clipboardImageIntake.scope: User reported having already tried screenshot paste; when asked for the result, explicitly confirmed that pasting automatically saved the image to drafts; no repeat test was required

externalLocalImageOpen.scope: User selected the single-image library material, used its local-open action, and confirmed that the computer opened the original image normally
